WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_records
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  g.zoneref,
  g.entrystat,
  g.avg_traitcount,
  g.record_count,
  CAST(g.record_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.total_records AS FLOAT) as fraction
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE t.total_records > 0
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
